Reference image. The first image is the primary reference (composite all identities onto it). SCAIL-2: extra batch images are used as additional views (back view, close-up, occluded background), each needing a matching reference_image_mask in that identity's color.
SCAIL-2 only. Colored reference mask, batch matching reference_image (first = primary reference mask, rest = identity masks for the additional reference_image).
CLIP vision features for conditioning. Model is trained with stretch resize to aspect ratio.
Cumulative output frame this chunk begins at. Wire from the previous chunk's video_frame_offset output.
Tail frames of previous_frames to anchor. SCAIL-2 trained at 5 (81-frame chunks, 76-frame step).
SCAIL-2 only. Full decoded output of the previous chunk. Only the last previous_frame_count are used as the extension anchor.
Empty latent of the generation size.
Adjusted offset + length. Wire into the next chunk.

schema.description: Merge coincident vertices via L_inf grid quantization. Use when a mesh comes in unwelded (per-face verts, no shared edges) - pre-pass before FillHoles, DecimateMesh, or any topology-aware op. Colors averaged per cluster.

interface.doc: Weld tolerance (fraction of bbox diagonal). 1e-5 for float dedup; 1e-3 for visibly-close-but-distinct verts.
Absolute weld tolerance (overrides epsilon_rel when > 0).

schema.description: Generates the ABC notation of a song from style and lyrics. Connect abc to YuE2 Generate Music node.

interface.doc: full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.
Number of recent ABC tokens used to penalize repetition.

schema.description: Generates music tokens and acoustic conditioning from style, lyrics, and an ABC notation. Provide the generated seconds to the Empty YuE2 Latent Audio node. An empty ABC input ignores the selected mode.

interface.doc: Connect the ABC generator or supply an edited score. Leave empty to use off mode automatically.
full: generates melody and chords; melody: generates melody only, recommended for covers.
Maximum duration in seconds. Automatically reduced for long prompts; generation can stop earlier.
Autoregressive guidance for style and lyrics. 1.0 disables CFG, matching the ABC workflow. Use 1.01 to match the original off-mode guidance.
